metrics.label: total views, first esports hashtag challenge in Vietnam

challenge: TikTok was gaining ground in Vietnam and matched the Free Fire audience, but Free Fire Esports had no channel there and no esports hashtag challenge existed in the market.
actions: Spotted TikTok’s fit with the target audience, launched the channel in September 2020, and partnered with TikTok on #khoanhkhacesports, producing 60+ videos in one month.
results: Fan page grown to 1M likes; 2 campaigns in Buzzmetrics’ monthly Top 10 (2020); #1 Gaming and #3 YouTube trending
